FN-NR6N7J8-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 8
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 8 as introduced would codify current practices of the Alabama Emergency
Management Agency to use its appropriated funds to purchase items that support the functions
of the department, including public educational materials on emergency preparedness.
